description: ELK GROVE – Elk Grove City Councilwoman Stephanie Nguyen’s campaign forState Assembly released the following statement in response to the Sacramento CountyRegistrar of Voters final Primary Election results: “I am extremely excited that our campaign to build a Sacramento region for all wassuccessful in securing the top spot in the Primary Election. While we are happy at theresults, this race is far from over, but our campaign is strong and has the momentum andsupport needed to win in November.Spe
